head: Knot Pilot: free knot tying app for iPhone shows each knot in 3D
dek: Knot Pilot ties each knot step by step in 3D, and you can turn the rope, slow it down and follow a hint for where the end goes next. It came out on 25 November and was #67 in free Reference apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: Each knot has written steps too, and you can search by the knot's name or by what you need it for and save favourites. It works offline, and a rope sandbox lets you tie and save your own rope scenes. It suggests six knots to start with: figure-eight, bowline, clove hitch, reef knot, sheet bend, and round turn with two half hitches. It's made by Sergii Nesterenko.
where: iPhone and iPad with iOS 26 or later; free
means: If you've ever given up on a knot diagram, this lets you watch the knot tied from any side at your own speed.
todo: Get it free from the App Store; start with the six knots it suggests.
